item.title: Longbridge nearly doubles Q4 profit as parent Ellington reports weaker performance
item.description: Longbridge Financial's Q4 net income rose to $16.4 million as originations hit $529.7 million, while Ellington earnings declined.

item.title: HomeXpress launches on ARIVE, expanding broker access to non-QM and investor loans
item.description: California-based lender HomeXpress Mortgage Corp. announced Thursday that it has launched on the ARIVE platform, allowing approved brokers to access HomeXpress products and pricing on ARIVE's loan origination system.

item.title: Real estate agents take notice: Rising consumer delinquencies are repositioning the housing market
item.description: Student-loan delinquencies rose to 16.3% in Q4, New York Fed data shows, as overall delinquency hit 4.8% and foreclosures increase.

item.title: REMAX President Chris Lim on real estate’s inflection moment
item.description: Lim sat down with HousingWire during REMAX's R4 conference — outlining key partnerships, initiatives and market perspective.

item.title: eXp World Holdings seeks reincorporation from Delaware to Texas
item.description: eXp seeks to reincorporate from Delaware to Texas, with a shareholder vote set for April 24, 2026, per a Wednesday SEC filing.

item.title: Hovnanian recalibrates amid a shift to a higher-margin mix
item.description: Hovnanian reported Q1 2026 net income of $20.9M, but gross margin fell to 13.4% as incentives stayed elevated.

item.title: Compass Coming Soon listings to appear on Redfin
item.description: Compass will syndicate coming soon listings to Redfin on March 16, with seller opt out and 24 hour lead claim for listing agents.

item.title: Rocket grows revenue to $6.7B, expands market share in 2025
item.description: Rocket CEO Varun Krishna said the results capped a “transformational year” for the company, citing stronger market share and growth.

item.title: Rocket Pro doubles broker credits with Compass deal, unveils ‘Jupiter’ LOS
item.description: Rocket Pro announced a partnership with Compass to offer additional credits to brokers and unveiled a new loan origination system during its Ignite26 event.
